export_reload_contract.canonical_joint_terminal: one immutable V7 fixed-wire artifact plus one immutable joint checkpoint state payload

joint_checkpoint_state.schema: state maps: luts, norms, outputs plus Adam/scheduler/next_update/objective/invariants
joint_checkpoint_state.serialization: atomic immutable torch checkpoint plus SHA-bound JSON sidecar; final checkpoint has no optimizer replay ambiguity

recovered_consumer.gain_deployment: materialize_with_gain attaches exactly one exp(clamp(log_gain,-0.25,0.25)) hook to each of 43 o_b_proj modules from checkpoint state.outputs
recovered_consumer.lut_deployment: V7 loader consumes exact FP16 LUT slots exported from checkpoint luts
recovered_consumer.norm_deployment: OverlaySafeOpen replaces exactly 235 native RMSNorm BF16 tensors from checkpoint state.norms
recovered_consumer.required_seen_sets: 43/43 LUTs, 235/235 norms, 43/43 gains before terminal acceptance

reload_acceptance: checkpoint SHA and sidecar validate weights-only
joint objective after deployed reload strictly lower

v7_quant_wire_export.scope: exactly 43 FP16[1024] LUT slot replacements; packed members/codes/assignments/scales unchanged

wire_reporting.rule: never include overlay bytes implicitly in the V7 quant-wire number; report overlay state and quant-wire separately

optimizer_schedule_checkpoint.checkpoint_contract: atomic durable checkpoint after every update with complete LUT masters, dense norm/output state, Adam state, scheduler state, and next_update; strict identity-bound resume only
optimizer_schedule_checkpoint.predeclared_terminal: sustained lower deployed/reloaded TRAIN objective with diminishing positive gain per step; freeze exactly one candidate before any evaluation

prior_working_path_proof.causal_statement: The preserved trainer executes one ordered end-to-end TRAIN objective, accumulates ordered backward calls over its fixed segments, then performs one Adam optimizer step jointly across all live codebooks, all RMSNorm FP32 masters, and all 43 output gains. The V7 adaptation changes only the codebook artifact surface to the exact 43 layer LUT roster below; objective ordering, joint optimizer/update semantics, dense surfaces, frozen packed/code/assignment policy, schedule, checkpoint, and deployed serialization remain unchanged.

full_model_train_bank.forbidden_substitute: per-layer TRAIN X/Y captures cannot drive the joint norm/output-gain objective
full_model_train_bank.source: eval-disjoint DS4 TRAIN corpus and existing banked top-8192 teacher targets

train_objective.kind: ordered joint whole-model TRAIN loss against existing banked teacher targets
train_objective.ordered_semantics: for every fixed segment: segment_weight=len(segment_wins)/len(wins); ordered_backward([segment_loss*segment_weight]); exactly one optimizer.step after all segments
